description: This Java source file defines the StoreFilter class, which is a web request interceptor used in a Spring-based e-commerce application. It manages session attributes, localization, breadcrumb navigation, caching of content and configuration data, and initializes various store-related objects before handling requests.

classes.name: StoreFilter
classes.description: A Spring Web HandlerInterceptorAdapter that intercepts incoming HTTP requests to initialize session attributes, perform localization, manage cache-based content and configuration retrieval, and generate breadcrumbs for an e-commerce store.

methods.name: preHandle
methods.description: Main method invoked before request handling. Manages session attributes, locale, content caching, breadcrumb setup, and store configuration. Branches to bypass certain URLs and handles store/customer/content initialization.

methods.name: getMerchantConfigurations
methods.description: Retrieves configuration settings for a store, using cache if enabled, and sets them as request attributes.

methods.name: getContentPageNames
methods.description: Fetches and caches content page descriptions for navigation and UI purposes, updating request attributes accordingly.

methods.name: getContentObjects
methods.description: Retrieves content objects (such as boxes and sections), caches them, and attaches to request scope.

methods.name: getTopCategories
methods.description: Fetches and caches top-level category data for navigation menus.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Loads category data from the database, organized by locale, for caching and UI.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Fetches content entities (boxes, sections) from the database, organized by language, for caching and rendering.

methods.name: getConfigurations
methods.description: Loads store configurations and merchant-specific settings from the database.

methods.name: setBreadcrumb
methods.description: Builds breadcrumb trail based on current page context, supporting localization and dynamic content.

methods.name: getDefaultBreadcrumbItem
methods.description: Creates a default 'Home' breadcrumb item with localized label.

methods.name: setMerchantStoreInSession
methods.description: Sets the MerchantStore object into the session based on store code.
